overview: Designed to provide instant hot water, Parry Quick fit sink tables are supplied with factory fitted hot and cold pipework and are able to be installed easily to a domestic water supply for intake and a 1 ¼ inch outlet pipe. Requiring a 13 amp plug socket to power the integral boiler system provides the user with a hot water system and sink system with minimal install required.

All Parry Quick Fit sinks are supplied fully welded, along with adjustable feet for uneven surfaces, and an undershelf for additional storage. They are available in a number of configurations from left/right hand drainers, and twin bowl designs, all of which include a splashback to prevent mess. Please be sure to specify when ordering, all manufactured out of high quality stainless steel.
features: 10L or 30L integral water boiler (dependant on model)
